name: Melatonin

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The pineal hormone that signals biological night, sold in the United States as a dietary supplement and regulated as a prescription medicine in several other countries. Product content has repeatedly been found to differ substantially from label claim.

systems.note: Chronobiotic signalling at MT1 and MT2 receptors shifting sleep timing; the intended effect.
Reported effects on reproductive hormone timing; the signal is weak and contested.

monitors.why: Sleep and affect are coupled; the accessible instrument.
